about: Pairwise model for docker_volume (Pass 6b Lane W), local driver (plain harness pass). Each attribute is checked against GET /volumes/{name} through the contract's inspect field map. null = attribute not set. The writable surface of a local volume is small: cluster_volume_spec needs a CSI volume plugin, which the harness does not have, so it is not modelled.

name.no_inspect_reason: the volume is looked up by this name; a generated name is checked by the lookup succeeding

adopt.no_inspect_reason: provider-side switch (take over an existing volume of the same name); nothing in inspect
